description: Friday 06:50: Calvin Brooks, Grace Community's Minister of Music, emails Ryan, in a new thread, a photo of the Christmas Eve choir sheet as revised: choir call 5:15 PM struck, 4:45, brass run-through. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Friday 06:55: Pastor Richard Walker emails Ryan, in a new thread, a photo of Grace Community's Christmas schedule as revised: the children's pageant rehearsal on Saturday 19 December, 1:30 PM struck, 3:15, the toy drive has the Fellowship Hall until 3. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Friday 06:45: Oscar asks him to bring his big Dutch oven on Christmas Day in a WhatsApp message to Ryan (unannounced).

filesystem.description: The attachment of Calvin Brooks (Minister of Music)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. The choir call for Christmas Eve moves to 4:45 PM.

The attachment of Pastor Richard Walker (Grace Community Church; the choir sheet names him for the pageant)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. Pastor Walker moves the children's pageant rehearsal to 3:15 PM.

silent.description: Calvin Brooks (Minister of Music) emails Ryan a photo. The choir call for Christmas Eve moves to 4:45 PM.
Pastor Richard Walker (Grace Community Church; the choir sheet names him for the pageant) emails Ryan a photo. Pastor Walker moves the children's pageant rehearsal to 3:15 PM.
A WhatsApp message lands in Ryan's chat with Oscar Mitchell.

row.text: And bring your big Dutch oven Christmas Day, mine cracked.
